lastFeature: 0.5.34 RELEASED (live, both platforms) — weather-current-predict, released from the Mac. The feature was built + Chronicled on the VM (commit a0cafa5; records all updated incl. PRIVACY_POLICY.md for the new live/forecast data flow) and the v0.5.34 tag pushed; this Mac session pulled (fast-forwarded main to a0cafa5), verified the bump (package.json + tauri.conf.json both 0.5.34, CHANGELOG entry), then ran ./release.sh. macOS universal DMG notarized (Apple submission 6fc61e41-3209-41f4-b8da-723be3480152, Accepted) + stapled, bundle-version guard 0.5.34; Windows installer fetched from CI + signed locally; latest.json all three keys (darwin-aarch64 + darwin-x86_64 -> the one universal updater bundle/same sig, windows-x86_64 -> SnowRaven_0.5.34_x64-setup.exe). All 6 release assets HEAD 200; GitHub /releases/latest confirms v0.5.34 is Latest (not draft/prerelease), target main, published 2026-06-14T06:12:38Z. RELEASE HAZARD CAUGHT THIS SESSION: the v0.5.34 tag had been re-pushed (false-start) — first at orphaned commit c1b7ff2, then moved to a0cafa5 — leaving TWO Windows CI runs. release.sh selects the Windows artifact by `gh run list --workflow windows-build.yml --status success --limit 1` (most-recently-CREATED success); its only guard checks the installer FILENAME contains the version, which CANNOT distinguish two same-version commits. The stale c1b7ff2 run finished success FIRST and briefly sat at the top of the selection list. Mitigation: waited for the correct a0cafa5 run (27489978328, created later -> sorts above c1b7ff2 once green) to finish success, then verified `.[0].headSha == a0cafa5` before running release.sh. The published Windows installer is from the correct commit. Feature (built on the VM): Current & Predict — two buttons at the bottom of the Weather tab. Current = one-tap live weather + tide for the device location, resolved in the LOCATION's timezone. Predict = forecast weather + predicted tide for a chosen place (Nominatim search + draggable map pin) / date / time. Weather ~8 days out (hourly <=48h, labeled daily 48h-8d, out-of-range >8d); tide astronomical so it runs much further with an honest no-forecast note past the weather window. Independent sources (one fails, the other still shows); copy-ready block reuses the existing checklist formatter byte-for-byte. Built on existing providers (OpenWeather, NOAA, Nominatim) — no new providers, privacy promise unchanged. QA PASSED (889 frontend + 131 backend tests, 16/16 acceptance criteria, mostly live-verified, no regression to the existing checklist lookup). Security PASSED with notes (privacy-policy update done in-stage; two informational findings accepted). Convention flag from QA: added a backend route -> add its prefix to the vite dev proxy (the /tide prefix had been missing, which also broke the existing checklist tide in vite-dev). Artifacts in pipeline/weather-current-predict/. In-app updater not yet user-confirmed in-app (latest.json correct, so detection is ready). (Prior: 0.5.33 media-sex-age-filters released live.)
